title: A Failed Ointment Venture, a Brother's Push and Kalbe's Garage
conflicts: The 1961 Wim Kalona request: Rp30 million for herbal-remedy research with advice to found a company (detik quoting his 2015 talk; CNN Indonesia) vs Rp1.5 million for skin-medicine research that Kalona agreed to back (CNBC Indonesia); story follows his own account, attributed. Garage: owned by a patient of his elder brother (his telling, detik/CNN) vs a Tanjung Priok house rented from his own patient (CNBC); both given. Reasons the 1963 venture closed differ (capital, marketing, unprofessional running); all given. Founder count (five siblings vs five colleagues), birth year (1933 vs 1943) and age at death (89 vs 80) disagree; none used.
notes: Main sources are Indonesian-language (detik, CNN Indonesia, CNBC Indonesia, Kontan) plus a Forbes profile; his words are paraphrased. The episode is told as a second attempt after a failed first venture, which the slate did not mention. Kalbe's own history pages are JavaScript-only and could not be read.
